Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: PulseQueue
Punchline: Latest input wins. Exact action. Responsive timing.
Description: A strict 180 ms one-shot buffer with same-slot Direct and action-only Macro Turbo.
Changelog: Turbo now repeats the same certified hotbar slot: direct slots follow Viper/combo transformations, and action-only multi-action macros use a bounded 0..ActionCount epoch with at most one accepted action. A newer Heal, Purify, Guard, or other certified input can replace only PulseQueue's exact older queued action. Defaults are 0/60 ms; rejection ends the hold without retry. NoClippy is supported. ReAction Turbo Hotbars, Macro Queue, and Auto Target must stay off; Auto Dismount and Camera Relative may remain on.
